description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP

PROBLEM INFO:

- A division of an auto parts manufacturer produces \var{P} different parts using \var{M} different machines.
- Batch of 100 part \var{p} requires \var{time_{m,p}} hours on machine \var{m}.
- The division incurs a charge of \var{cost_{m}} per hour for using machine \var{m}.
- Machine \var{m} has an availability of up to \var{available_{m}} hours per month.
- The division sells part \var{p} in batches of 100 at price of \var{price_{p}} per batch.
- The division must produce at least \var{min_batches_{p}} batches of part \var{p} each month to fulfill a contract.
- Machine \var{1} is being outsourced so that the manufacturer must pay for the labor.
- The labor costs $\var{standard_cost}/h up to \var{overtime_hour} hours, after which it costs $\var{overtime_cost}/h due to overtime.
- Individual availability conditions for Machine \var{1} can be disregarded.
- The desired profit should surpass \var{min_profit}.

INPUT FORMAT: 

{
    "time_required": [[time_{m,p} for p in 1, ..., P] for m in 1, ..., M],
    "machine_costs": [cost_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "availability": [available_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "prices": [price_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "min_batches": [min_batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "standard_cost": standard_cost,
    "overtime_cost": overtime_cost,
    "overtime_hour": overtime_hour,
    "min_profit": min_profit
}

OBJECTIVE: Determine the quantity of batches for each part the manufacturer should produce every month, ensuring all constraints are met.

OUTPUT INFO:

- the number of batches of each part produced \var{batches_{p}}.
- \var{total_profit} represents the total profit obtained for the month.

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "batches": [batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "total_profit": total_profit
}

P.definition: Number of parts to be produced

TimeRequired.definition: Time required to produce each part 'p' on machine 'm'

Availability.definition: Availability in hours of each machine 'm' per month

Prices.definition: Price obtained from selling each part 'p'

MinBatches.definition: Minimum number of batches of part 'p' that must be produced

StandardCost.definition: Standard cost for a machine to run for one hour

OvertimeCost.definition: Overtime cost for a machine to run for one hour beyond the standard availability

OvertimeHour.definition: Numbers of overtime hours available for a machine to run beyond standard availability

MinProfit.definition: The minimum profit the manufacturer wants to achieve

objective.description: "Maximize the total monthly profit from producing and selling the batches of parts, accounting for machine usage costs and labor (including overtime) costs."
objective.formulation:
$\max \left( \sum_{p=1}^{P} Prices_p \, batches_p 
\;-\; \sum_{m=2}^{M} MachineCosts_m \left( \sum_{p=1}^{P} TimeRequired_{m,p} \, batches_p \right) 
\;-\; StandardCost \cdot standardHours 
\;-\; OvertimeCost \cdot overtimeHours \right)$

constraints.description: For each machine m ≠ 1: the total processing time used by all parts on machine m cannot exceed its available hours, i.e., sum over p of (TimeRequired[m,p] * batches_p) ≤ Availability[m]
For machine 1: let standard_hours and overtime_hours be the labor hours used, then sum over p of (TimeRequired[1,p] * batches_p) = standard_hours + overtime_hours
For each part p: batches_p ≥ MinBatches[p]
Total profit must be at least MinProfit
constraints.formulation: $\\sum_{p=1}^{P} Prices_p \\cdot batches_p - \\left( \\sum_{m=2}^{M} MachineCosts_m \\cdot \\sum_{p=1}^{P} TimeRequired_{m,p} \\cdot batches_p + StandardCost \\cdot standardHours + OvertimeCost \\cdot overtimeHours \\right) \\geq MinProfit$

standardHours.definition: Number of standard labor hours used on machine 1

overtimeHours.definition: Number of overtime labor hours used on machine 1

batches.definition: Number of batches of part p produced per month
